Hi Olivia — great to connect. Re-forwarding the key options we typically offer for early-stage pilots (hosted API only):

• Starter Credit Pack (3-month): prepaid credit that gives a blended per-token rate with a small upfront commitment (e.g., $6k/month recommended for your scale). Credits expire at the end of the term unless you convert to a monthly retainer.
• Monthly Minimum with Roll-over Buffer: modest monthly minimum (e.g., $3k/mo) with 20% roll-over credit allowed to the next month for unused credits during the pilot. This is invoiceable and easy for procurement.
• Usage + Soft-Commit: no upfront payment; we provide a discounted per-token rate if you commit to a forecast band (1–3M tokens) and we invoice monthly with overage at the listed rate.

Embeddings: priced per-embedding unit (separate SKU) — we can fold a small embedding bundle into the starter pack if you want.

I’ve looped in Aditya to confirm what we can offer contractually and Marissa for rate-card PDF. Would you like a single-line 3-month agreement that we can sign (DocuSign) or are you looking for month-to-month invoiceable commitments?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Quick note on practical structuring for procurement:

1) For budget teams that prefer invoice line items, we offer a 3-month Starter Pack agreement (invoice upfront or monthly) with an explicit cancellation window of 30 days after the initial term.
2) We can build a simple clause: unused credits up to 25% can be rolled into month 2; beyond that, credits are forfeited unless customer converts to a retainer.
3) If Circuit wants to avoid upfront cash, we can do a 1-month minimum that auto-renews for up to 3 months with an optional termination at month 2 with 30 days notice — slightly higher per-token rate but reduces procurement friction.

Marissa — attaching the rate card draft; pls confirm the public hosted list rates and a starter-pack discount band we can offer for early-stage pilots (target net 15–20% off list across generation + embeddings).

- Aditya
